# Tofunmi Creative

> Tofunmi Creative is a digital agency that helps small businesses, startups, and solo founders turn website traffic into revenue. Services include Shopify store design and development, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), AI website building, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and product launch marketing. Listed on Trustpilot under "Website Designer."

## What we do

- Shopify store design and development: conversion-focused store design, product pages, cart flow, and checkout optimization.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): data-driven CRO audits, A/B testing, and UX improvements for Shopify stores doing $1k to $50k per month.
- AI website building: fast, modern websites built with AI for small businesses.
- AEO services: making brands easy for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) to find and recommend.
- Product launch marketing: landing pages and campaign design for new product launches.

## Who we help

Shopify store owners, ecommerce brands, small businesses, startups, and solo founders who want more sales without increasing ad spend.
